title: Technology
source: CTechnology::LoadKey (0x134AC0, 19 keys) and CTechStatistics::LoadKey (0x137DB0, 47 keys) read out of the game: reversing/findings/FINDINGS-fieldmap.md, reversing/findings/FINDINGS-research.md, BiceLib GameClasses/CTechnology.hpp and CCountryHistory.hpp; a unit type's name takes a CSubUnitDefinition delta (CLASSES.md "How a technology reaches a unit"); `tactic_` keys (reversing/findings/FINDINGS-combatview.md section 11); mission blocks (reversing/findings/FINDINGS-navalmissions.md section 10, MissionIndexToOrderToken in ghidra/project.json)

patterns.desc: a technology, named by its key

technology.desc: a technology: its own keys, its country-wide effects, and its effect on each unit type in a block named after the type

allow.desc: whether a country may research a level; also decides a one-level technology's place in a default historical model

change.desc: no for a doctrine: costs nothing to upgrade and moves a whole level a day

on_completion.desc: the technology category (a practical or a theory from common/technology.txt) a level finished raises

start_year.desc: the year of its first level

first_offset.desc: years from start_year to the first level

additional_offset.desc: years between levels; 0 makes it a one-level technology

difficulty.desc: research cost: (difficulty x 0.1 + 1) x 125; read as a whole number, so 0.5 is 0

is_nuclear.desc: adds the nuclear research modifier to its research bonus

activate_unit.desc: a unit type a level makes available

can_upgrade.desc: whether brigades are upgraded to its new levels

research_bonus_from.desc: categories whose experience lowers the research cost

build_cost_ic_modifier.desc: a per-unit-type build cost modifier; the mod and the base game never use it, and its shape was not read

build_cost_mp_modifier.desc: a per-unit-type manpower cost modifier; never used, shape not read

build_time_modifier.desc: a per-unit-type build time modifier; never used, shape not read

id.desc: an id; no technology file writes one

patterns.desc: what each level does to that unit type: a unit definition holding only the changes, scaled by the level
a combat tactic's weight, a whole percentage per level (CTechStatistics keeps any `tactic_` key)
the combined arms bonus of that group from common/combined_arms.txt, a fraction per level (the country's table of them is read; how the loader fills it was not)

unit_effect.desc: a technology's effect on one unit type, each figure added per level

research_bonus_from.desc: category = weight; the country's experience in each category, times its weight, lowers the research cost (at most 90%)

patterns.desc: a theory from common/technology.txt and its weight

decay.desc: category = figure, a fraction; the tooltip prints one line per category (FINDINGS-techtext.md), the shape is Their Finest Hour's own usage

mission.desc: a mission's figures; the two are what the game keeps per mission, the loader of the block was not read

efficiency.desc: mission efficiency, a fraction per level

reduction_modifier.desc: the mission's organisation penalty; read and never used in this build (FINDINGS-navalmissions.md section 10)
